FirstImpressionsQuestStart: ^"So, they finally think you're ready, huh?"
^"If you're serious about this mission, you'll need to prove it first. The Captain is waiting for you."

where_captain: ^"You'll find him in the training grounds near the capital. Try not to embarrass yourself."

CaptainDialogue: ^"You've made it this far. That means they see potential in you. But, potential is not enough. We do not guess if you are worthy, you are tested."
^The Captain folds his arms, glaring at the MC critically.
^"Your mission requires more than just brute strength. You must have a sly tongue, a stone heart, and a quick mind."
^"So, before I test you myself, make sure you don't embarrass yourself."
^The Captain gestures towards the worn-out training dummy

b: ^"Already think you're above this? Let's see if your skill matches your arrogance."
^The Captain shakes their head. ^"You're not leaving until you've shown me you can pass this. Try again."

check_result: ^The Captain observes your training from afar.

b: ^"Not bad. Up to you if you'll go again."

DuelWithCaptain: ^The Captain stands firm, his helmet conceling any emotion.
^"You've made it this far, but that means nothing. Show me you're ready."

c-1: ^"Nerves? Fine. Just don't keep me waiting."

duel_result: ^<i>The Captain studies you, gauging your performance.<i>

b: ^The Captain steps back, lowering his weapon back down to his side
^"Not bad. You might actually survive out there."
^The Captain's blade is at your throat before you can react, the weight of failure sinking in as the combat exercise ends. ^"If that was a real fight, you'd be dead. Again!"

duel_passed: ^"Alright. I think you've proven yourself...for now. Time for your first real mission."
